text:
maya: hey team — first week setup question. On a company Mac (Ventura), connected to WireGuard VPN with split-tunnel. I can hit google and Slack, but `docker pull internal-registry.redwood:5000/my-image` just sits and times out. Anyone seen this?

alex: welcome! :wave: quick Q — can you ping the registry hostname or its IP?

maya: ping internal-registry.redwood -> unknown host. nslookup times out.

alex: sounds DNS-related. For split-tunnel we push internal DNS search domains; double-check `scutil --dns` and see if search domain is there.

maya: running `scutil --dns` gives me only my ISP DNS entries. I guess split tunnel didn't apply the internal DNS.

tyler: did you install the company profile for WireGuard? on mac we rely on the profile to add the 10.0.0.0/8 route and company DNS.

maya: followed the onboarding doc, but it's the user-managed WireGuard app (not the system profile). Maybe that's it.

alex: two quick workarounds: 1) add a route via the bastion + use SSH SOCKS: `ssh -D 1080 -J bastion.redwood@jumphost` then point docker to `--config` with proxy; or 2) manually add the DNS search & route for this session: `sudo route -n add 10.45.0.0/16 10.2.3.1` and `networksetup -setdnsservers Wi-Fi 10.2.3.2` (replace iface/ip as appropriate).

maya: would prefer not to mess with route persistently. How do I do the SSH SOCKS approach for docker pulls?

tyler: for a quick test, you can enable a local proxy and export `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` so docker uses it. e.g.:
```
ssh -N -D 1080 alex@bastion.redwood
export HTTP_PROXY=socks5://localhost:1080
export HTTPS_PROXY=socks5://localhost:1080
docker pull internal-registry.redwood:5000/my-image
```
It usually works for a quick unblock.

maya: trying that now...

infra-bot: IT ticket created: #IT-4582 for maya — network team will verify split-tunnel profile and DNS push.

maya: ok docker pull works over the socks proxy, so definitely DNS/route. Thanks!

alex: cool. I'll add a note to onboarding docs to call out the WireGuard app vs profile difference and the SSH proxy tip. @it-support can you follow up on making sure new hires get the profile?

it-support: got it, I'll check the provisioning flow and include an automatic step to push the system profile for macs. ETA EOD.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
